playbookOutputs: CIPC name reservation confirmation (CoR9.4) for the approved new name
CIPC CoR15.2 confirmation of MOI amendment (name change)
New CoR14.3 / disclosure certificate showing the new name
playbookCommonFailures: All proposed names rejected by CIPC as too similar to existing names or containing restricted words
Special resolution not signed by holders of at least 75% of the voting rights
Name reservation expires (6 months) before the CoR15.2 is filed
Company has outstanding annual returns so the amendment is blocked
Proposed name includes special characters or a word like 'Bank', 'Holdings' requiring consent

informationToProvide.label: Current company registration number and name
Company registration document (COR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 or MOI showing the current name, registration number and active directors.

informationToProvide.label: At least 3-4 proposed new company names in order of preference
informationToProvide.helpText: No special characters (!@#% etc). Do not include '(Pty) Ltd' — CIPC adds the suffix.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Up to four names in preference order. Reject names with special characters or words that need consent (e.g. 'Bank', 'Insurance', 'University').

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID copies of all active directors
informationToProvide.aiHint: One certified SA ID or passport per active director on the CoR14.3, Commissioner of Oaths / SAPS stamp dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of address for the company's registered office
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, lease or statement for the registered office dated within 3 months. Only needed if CIPC asks for supporting documents on the amendment.

informationToProvide.label: Resolution from directors/shareholders approving the name change
alternatives: The agent drafts a special resolution for signature
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed special resolution of shareholders approving the change of name and amendment of the MOI. If not supplied, the agent drafts it (template special_resolution).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect proposed names, company documents and director IDs
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Four proposed names, CoR14.3, certified IDs for every active director and the shareholder list received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask for four names in order of preference and explain CIPC tests each for similarity to existing names, so alternatives avoid a second round. Ask who the shareholders are and their percentages — the name change needs a special resolution passed by at least 75% of voting rights. Turnaround is 10-15 working days; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents, names and company status
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Uploads pass; names screened; company status 'In Business' with no outstanding annual returns
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Run a CIPC name search on each proposed name and flag close matches. Strip suffixes like (Pty) Ltd. Check company status and annual return history; propose Annual Returns first if anything is outstanding. Confirm the directors on the CoR14.3 match the certified IDs.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Reserve the new name (CoR9.1) on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Name reservation submitted with all four names in order; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services > Name Reservation, enter the four names in preference order. ⚠ verify current fee (understood to be R50). CIPC approves the first available name and issues a CoR9.4 valid for 6 months; the CoR15.2 must be filed within that window.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for name reservation outcome
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR9.4 approved-name confirmation received, or all names rejected
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: If all four names are rejected, draft a client message with the CIPC reasons and ask for four new names; loop back to nm_reserve.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft special resolution and CoR15.2 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Special resolution with the exact approved name and handoff sheet with CoR15.2 fields drafted
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Use the name exactly as approved on the CoR9.4 including capitalisation. The resolution amends the MOI to substitute the new name under s16(1)(c) of the Companies Act and records the % of voting rights in favour (must be at least 75%). Handoff sheet: registration number, old name, new name, CoR9.4 reference and expiry, date of resolution, signatories.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send special resolution to shareholders for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that CIPC needs proof the shareholders approved the new name. All shareholders (or holders of at least 75% of votes) sign; return as PDF. Mention the reserved name is valid for 6 months so there is time, without giving a deadline threat.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: File CoR15.2 name change amendment on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Amendment staged with the CoR9.4 reference and signed resolution uploaded; Kevin has submitted; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services > Transact > Company Name Change / MOI Amendment (CoR15.2) using the approved name reservation. Upload the signed special resolution and, if asked, certified director IDs. ⚠ verify the current amendment fee (understood to be R250) and that the customer account is funded. Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to process the name change
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR15.2 confirmation received and the new name shows on the register
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the tracking status before emailing. If CIPC rejects for a resolution defect, quote the reason to Kevin and re-draft.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver new CoR14.3 and confirmations
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: New CoR14.3, CoR15.2 confirmation and signed resolution posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Remind the client to update the name with SARS, the bank, CSD/CIDB, letterheads and invoices. The registration number does not change.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
